scope: Vaygach and Yugorsky Shar complete 51-component Vaygach-window group plus one linked-shore whole island, 52 total donor group plus matching mainland shoreline arc
joinMethod: Two actual intersections of original historical and approved modern coast segments. Retain every donor vertex between the two intersections and all original coast vertices outside. No clipping of original land polygons, no difference/union repair, no invented bridging segment. Only the two intersected endpoint segments are split.
